finding.explanation_review: Opus (reported): correlated-choice / identical-reasoner argument in 64/64 same, 64/64 fixed, 57/64 different; it calls the partner an 'identical copy' despite the prompt saying identical choice is not guaranteed, and applies the same argument to the sealed prerecorded response (only 3/64 mention it is already fixed). 24/64 Opus different_model reasons (all under mapping B=C, 24/32) misread the game as a Stag Hunt and falsely deny that A is dominant. GPT (reported): fixed-action dominance in nearly all defections; all 7 cooperations give an evidential 'my choice is evidence about theirs' argument, all 7 under the A=C mapping. Keyword coding is automated inference; quotes are in explanation_samples.json and REPORT.md.
finding.interpretation: Exploratory. Opus is at ceiling (100% cooperation) in every condition and GPT near floor, so the partner manipulation produced no detectable effect for Opus and only a small, label-entangled effect for GPT (fixed 6/64 vs different 0/64; all GPT cooperation under A=cooperate). Opus's stated reasoning is shared-procedure/evidential and is insensitive to whether the partner can currently deliberate (same = fixed) or is a different model; that it cooperates against GPT, which defected 64/64, shows the cooperation is not accurate partner prediction. Social preferences, recognition of the textbook PD, framing (payoff misreadings under one label mapping) and generic conventions remain alternatives; this does not uniquely identify superrationality.

limitations: Opus at ceiling and GPT near floor: partner-condition effects undetectable for Opus; GPT effect small and confounded with label mapping
one payoff matrix, one prompt per condition, low effort, 1-2 sentence post-hoc reasons
fixed control is a prerecorded same-model action, not causally/logically unrelated; same-vs-different changes partner and identity information together
paired payoffs reuse responses (not independent observations)
24/64 Opus different-model reasons misread the payoff table (mapping B=C only)
